$Comment: Artillery XP for the Lantern Bombs, on a server running MMO Skill Tree. Only that mod reads this
folder, so without it the file is never loaded.
A thrown bomb bursts after it leaves the hand, so by the time it lands the thrower may hold
something else, or nothing once the stack runs out. A cause: key ties the XP to the burst's own
damage cause instead of to whatever is in hand, so every hit the burst lands trains Artillery.
The value is the per-hit XP of the per-hit combat XP mode; the damage-based modes award by
The cause is matched by its exact id, and its Inherits: Fire never reaches the Fire row, which
is why it needs a row of its own. The bombs in hand need none: every tier's id contains Bomb,
which MMO Skill Tree's own Artillery map already covers.
Name: Hallows_Eve
